chunking: Each FineWeb document's 'text' is tokenized with the Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B tokenizer using {'add_special_tokens': False, 'split_special_tokens': True} (no BOS/EOS or other special tokens added; literal special-token strings in the text are tokenized as ordinary text; no chat template). The token sequence is split into non-overlapping 64-token chunks starting at token 0: tokens[64k:64k+64] for k = 0..min(floor(len/64), 4)-1, i.e. at most 4 chunks per document (the first 4). The trailing remainder (< 64 tokens) is dropped; documents shorter than 64 tokens contribute no chunks. Documents are taken in stream order, chunks in document order; context_id = running index over all chunks. Each context's (doc_idx, fineweb id, chunk_idx) is saved.
activation: channel N of input to layers[L].mlp.down_proj = silu(gate_proj(x))*up_proj(x)
score: max over the 64 token positions; argmax position = first position attaining it
topk_tiebreak: higher value first, ties -> lower context id
spread: mean and std (population) of the per-context score over all contexts
